about.title: About me
about.body: Full Stack Software Engineer with proven experience building scalable, high-performance web applications end-to-end — from responsive interfaces with React/Next.js to robust backend systems with NestJS. Demonstrated ability to design real-time IoT data flows, optimize performance under high concurrency, and ship secure, production-ready solutions. Strong foundation in cloud infrastructure (AWS), asynchronous processing (Redis, BullMQ), and modern database architecture (PostgreSQL).
highlights: Sub-50ms TTFB on a real-time IoT alerting system
100% data integrity on critical modules via database transactions
